candidate.answerReason: Equal distances and the interior condition imply that OP bisects the 60° angle. Thus angle AOP is 30°.

methods.label: Identify the bisector and halve the angle
methods.explanation: Since \(P\) is equidistant from the two sides of the angle and lies inside it, \(OP\) bisects \(\angle AOB\), so \(\angle AOP=60^\circ\div2=30^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: The Grade 8 criterion identifies the bisector, followed by Grade 7 angle halving.
